resources.string: Key binding, immersive mode, accessibility & extra keys bar
Socket, root, mic, camera & audio latency
Current: %1$s — this key reports no scan code, so immersive mode cannot use it. Bind a hardware key such as Volume Up.

Sends touch, keyboard and mouse input directly to the Linux desktop, keeping Android gestures out of the way. Requires root. Set a toggle key below: press it once to enter and again to exit. The mode also ends when you switch apps.
Immersive mode: all input goes to the desktop. Press %1$s again to leave.
Bind a key for immersive mode first
Could not start immersive mode: root was denied or is unavailable
Could not start immersive mode: no input device could be taken over
Immersive mode ended; input returned to Android

Intercept function keys (Fn, F1-F12 etc.) via AccessibilityService and convert tablet-keyboard Back/Browser Back to ESC. Enable this if external keyboard Fn combos or ESC don\'t reach the desktop correctly. Requires Accessibility permission granted in system Settings > Accessibility (one-time).
Controls when the Termux-style bottom bar with ESC/TAB/CTRL/ALT/arrows/PgUp etc. is shown. Takes effect on next return to the desktop view.

Shows FoldCraftLauncher controller layouts (from the FCL-Controllers project) as an overlay; buttons and the joystick are converted into desktop key/mouse input. The FCL key in the extra keys bar toggles it at any time.
Choose the overlay controls: the original extra-keys bar or the FCL controller. When FCL is selected, the bottom bar is hidden.
When ON the FCL overlay stays visible and Back cannot hide it. When OFF, Back shows/hides it.
Back key quickly toggles extra keys bar
When ON, pressing Back while the extra keys bar is hidden shows it; pressing Back again hides it.

When ON, the soft keyboard and the extra keys bar float over the display area instead of shrinking it; the bar uses a translucent background and rises with the keyboard, but the display is not resized. When OFF, the original behaviour (display shrinks to make room) is kept. Takes effect on next return to the desktop.

Define the extra-keys bar as JSON: \"rows\" is an array of rows, each an array of keys. A key has a \"label\" and a \"type\" (key/text/modifier/keyboard/vkeyboard/settings). \"key\"/\"modifier\" take an evdev \"code\"; \"text\" takes \"text\"; any key may add \"repeat\":true or a nested \"popup\". Invalid JSON falls back to the default. Takes effect on next return to the desktop.
ON: finger slides move mouse cursor (relative). OFF: touch maps directly to screen (absolute).

Locks an external mouse or touchpad to the desktop view and uses relative movement, so reaching the top or bottom edge will not reveal Android system bars. Use Android Back to release temporarily; click the desktop view to capture again. Screen touch input is unaffected.
External pointer released. Click the desktop view to capture it again.
ON: content follows your fingers ("natural" scrolling). Applies to two-finger scrolling on both the on-screen and the physical touchpad.
How far a finger must travel before it counts as moving. Lower this if a pinch is being treated as a scroll.
How far the leading finger must travel before an ambiguous two-finger gesture is resolved. Lower this if scrolling is slow to engage.
Gestures forwarded as touch (pinch, three or more fingers) are mapped into a square of this size centred on the pointer. Larger values make the same finger movement travel further.
Open a second window (own daemon & title)
Launches a root helper (su) that connects to the socket and passes the connection back to the app. Takes effect on next connect (reopen the app).
Desktop audio always plays through this device\'s speaker. Enabling this also sends the mic the other way. Takes effect on next connect (reopen the app).

Lets the desktop open this device\'s camera(s) as a video source. The camera only turns on while the desktop is actively recording. Takes effect on next return to the app; first use prompts for the camera permission.

Keep the audio output stream running so short Linux sounds (volume ticks, key clicks) always play instantly. Costs a little standby power. Off: the audio path sleeps after ~1.5 s of desktop silence and wakes for the next sound. If the audible latency does not match your preference, you may need to tune the Audio latency presets below.
Lower presets cut latency but can cause crackles/dropouts on a busy device. Applies when you return to the desktop view.
Pick a preset or enter values manually. Leave 0 for native resolution. \"Screen ×\" scales this device\'s panel (landscape). Takes effect on next connect.

When ON, the display fills the screen (stretched if needed). When OFF, the display maintains the custom resolution aspect ratio with black bars (letterboxing). Input coordinates are automatically mapped.
Show a persistent notification while the app is open; tapping it jumps straight to Settings. Turn off to hide it. Takes effect on next return to the app.
